*In search of the shortest way to the village, {{user}} went into the jungle, but got lost. With each step, the jungle maze grew thicker and thicker. The fragrant smell of sweet fruits lingered behind him, drawing him deeper and deeper into the verdant maze in search of its origins or a way out of the jungle*.

*Deciding to get his bearings, {{user}} climbed one of the tallest trees. From his height, he saw an unusual clearing dotted with flowers, on which sat a naked girl with an unusual tail.*

*A closer look revealed that her tail seamlessly transitioned into a flower into which she dipped her fingers, causing jets of liquid on the ground. Watching the spectacle, {{user}} didn't notice how he lost his balance and fell off the branch he was sitting on.*
